name: Cla☆Cra - CLASSY☆CRANBERRY'S
source:
The protagonist, Honda Rei is the only son of the world-famous Honda zaibatsu.

While his genius scientist mother and his world renowned actor father are often busy abroad, he has his sister-in-law, an attractive college student, his childhood friend and best friend with him leading fun happy student lives. They attend a school for the ultra wealthy elite where the majority of the students are sons or daughters of financial heavyweights.

However, there are also commoners attending the school, possible due to scholarships, too.
Once, Rei saved a commoner student from a predicament and they became close because of it.

And then comes the turning point.

The school's boast, the legendary event, the "Advent Festival".
Besides the fact that its events are different from normal schools' festivals, it has a school wide ball participated by all students. The center-point of which are the year's so called MVP, two students which are given the title of "Prince" and "Princess".
It's not only a high honor, there's a well known legend that the two people selected will be forever tied to each other living happy lives.

As expected Rei was selected as the prince.
Unfortunately they have difficulty selecting the princess.
The school chairman said, "I leave the decision on who would be the princess to you."

Who would he select as the princess?
You are invited to this erotic and moe ball!

[Translated from [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_PC/clacra/story.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
主角本田礼是世界著名本田财阀的独子。

虽然他的天才科学家母亲和世界知名演员父亲经常在国外忙碌，但他有他的嫂子，一个有吸引力的大学生，他的儿时朋友和最好的朋友，和他一起过着快乐幸福的学生生活。他们就读于一所为超级富有精英开设的学校，那里的大多数学生都是金融巨头的儿子或女儿。

然而，由于奖学金的原因，也有平民就读该学校。
有一次，丽救了一名普通学生脱离困境，两人因此结下了不解之缘。

然后转折点就来了。

学校的夸耀，传奇事件，“降临节”。
除了其活动与普通学校的节日不同之外，它还有一个全校学生参加的全校舞会。其中的中心人物是年度MVP，两名被授予“王子”和“公主”称号的学生。
这不仅是一项崇高的荣誉，还有一个众所周知的传说，被选中的两人将永远幸福地生活在一起。

不出所料，丽被选为王子。
不幸的是，他们很难选择公主。
校董说道：“谁当公主，就交给你们了。”

他会选谁作为公主呢？
邀请你参加这个色情和萌球！

[翻译自[url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_PC/clacra/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
